text:
At room temperature, iron is difficult to compress.
At the same temperature, oxygen is much easier to compress.
Which comparison of the structures of iron and oxygen explains this?
A
The iron particles are closer together.
B
The iron particles have a greater mass.
C
The iron particles can be magnetised.
D
The iron particles have less average kinetic energy.

options.label: A
options.text: The iron particles are closer together.

options.label: B
options.text: The iron particles have a greater mass.

options.label: C
options.text: The iron particles can be magnetised.

options.label: D
options.text: The iron particles have less average kinetic energy.
